scientific_integrity: The exact divisor decomposition reduces the pointwise problem to a geometric sum in \(v_2(n)\). The summatory asymptotic follows from an absolutely convergent divisor rearrangement for \(s<0\), with explicit error bounds. Finite computation is only a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The pointwise sign classification is complete only for modulus \(q=2\). The summatory asymptotic covers every \(s<0\), but no eventual-sign claim is made for \(s\ge0\). No general modulus-\(q\) classification is asserted.
title: Parity-resolved divisor-power sums for \(q=2\)
